mapper.select: select status,response_json from sys_idempotency_record where idempotency_key=#{key} and user_id=#{userId} and operation=#{operation}
mapper.update: update sys_idempotency_record set status='COMPLETED',response_json=#{responseJson} where idempotency_key=#{key} and user_id=#{userId} and operation=#{operation}
mapper.select: select status from po_purchase_order where id=#{id} and deleted=0 for update
select count(*) from md_warehouse where id=#{id} and enabled=1 and deleted=0
select id from inv_receipt where receipt_no=#{receiptNo}

select i.material_id,i.quantity,i.received_quantity,m.tracking_mode from po_purchase_order_item i join md_material m on m.id=i.material_id where i.id=#{id} and i.purchase_order_id=#{purchaseOrderId} for update
mapper.update: update po_purchase_order_item set received_quantity=received_quantity+#{quantity},version=version+1,updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{id} and received_quantity+#{quantity}<=quantity
mapper.insert: insert into inv_batch(warehouse_id,material_id,batch_no,quantity) values(#{warehouseId},#{materialId},#{batchNo},#{quantity}) on duplicate key update quantity=quantity+values(quantity)
insert into inv_balance(warehouse_id,material_id,quantity,created_by,updated_by) values(#{warehouseId},#{materialId},0,#{userId},#{userId}) on duplicate key update id=id
mapper.select: select id,quantity,version from inv_balance where warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} and material_id=#{materialId} and deleted=0
mapper.update: update inv_balance set quantity=#{quantity},version=version+1,updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{id} and version=#{version}
mapper.select: select count(*) from po_purchase_order_item where purchase_order_id=#{purchaseOrderId} and received_quantity<quantity and deleted=0
mapper.update: update po_purchase_order set status=#{status},updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{id}
